answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16072 Country: India Title: in roza if we eat in forget fullness wat shall we do?afterwards do qaza? in roza if we masturbate will it break so we should do qada or kaffara? Question: in roza if we eat in forget fullness wat shall we do?afterwards do qaza? in roza if we masturbate will it break so we should do qada or kaffara? Answer ID: 16072 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1507/1513/L=1430) Eating or drinking forgetfully will not invalidate the fasting, rather it will remain intact. Yes, if someone eats or drinks forgetfully and misunderstood that his fast was nullified and ate or drank intentionally, so the fast will break and he will have to perform qadha at later time. (2) Masturbation invalidates fasting and renders qadha necessary but not kaffarah: او استمنی بکفہ ۔۔۔۔ قضی ( الدر المختار ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
